name: flightdeck
description: Flightdeck draws each flightdeck/workflow-graph/v1 record, an agent's reading of a workflow at /workflow-graphs/<slug>, as a graph. Run `board flightdeck check --path /workflow-graphs/<slug>` after each write; it lists what the page would refuse, such as an edge to an id that names nothing. `flightdeck open` shows the graphs on its Workflows page.

capabilities.name: check
capabilities.title: Check a workflow graph
capabilities.description: Read the flightdeck/workflow-graph/v1 record at a path and list the problems its schema cannot see, each with a code, the JSON pointer of the field at fault and a sentence. No problems means Flightdeck draws the graph.

path.description: The graph record that was checked.

problems.description: Each problem the check found, in the order of the record's fields; empty when there are none.
